card: This PR updates the macOS SDK version targeted in the build system to 15.0 while leaving the minimum supported runtime version at macOS 14.0. It is a necessary prerequisite for updating depends to Qt 6.12 LTS (#36593), which requires the macOS 15 SDK. Impact is limited to macOS cross-compilation and depends packaging environments.
evidence: Commit eaa8d1f5a5 / description: "Qt 6.12, which supports deployment targets up to macOS 26, requires the macOS 15 SDK or higher. See https://doc.qt.io/qt-6.12/macos.html. This is a prerequisite for the upcoming update of Qt in depends from 6.8 LTS to 6.12 LTS."
problem: Upgrading depends to Qt 6.12 requires the macOS 15.0 SDK or higher according to Qt's macOS platform requirements. The current build system uses an older SDK version, blocking the Qt upgrade.

risk.why: A faulty SDK bump can cause compilation failures or subtle binary incompatibilities in macOS release binaries generated via Guix.

scope_notes: Very small diff (+2/-2 across two build system files).
summary: Bump the macOS SDK version used by the build system and depends to 15.0. The minimum deployment target stays unchanged at macOS 14.0.
